# PayoutDelta - Cross-Border Remittance & Intermediary Fee Benchmark

> This is an llms.txt file. It is a standardized way to present information about a website to LLMs. Read more at https://llmstxt.org

> PayoutDelta benchmarks exactly what a USD 1,000 contractor payout loses inside the banking rail before it lands in the recipient's local account: correspondent SWIFT intermediary deductions (SHA), FX spreads, platform cuts and statutory withholding. The dataset covers 50 currency corridors — USD to Pakistan, India, the Philippines, Brazil, Mexico, Nigeria, the EU, plus 43 more markets — and is restated every time `data/fees.json` refreshes (dataset 2026-09-23, 50 corridors, 87 platform routes).

## PayoutDelta Guides

- [Rate Leaderboard](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/leaderboard): ranks all 50 corridors by the local-currency shortfall a USD 1,000 payout incurs across intermediary, invoice and direct rails.
- [Payout Calculator](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/calculator/usd-to-pkr): models intermediary cuts, FX spreads and statutory withholding per corridor, with platform presets (Upwork, Fiverr, Deel) across 87 long-tail routes.
- [Invoice Studio](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/invoice): contract-grade compliant invoices carrying the statutory purpose code and withholding for the selected corridor.
- [Regulatory / Tax Ledger](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/tax-ledger): per-corridor statutory purpose codes, tolerances and withholding rationale.
- [SWIFT Auditor](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/swift-auditor): reverse-engineers the correspondent route (direct vs SHA) for any destination BIC.
- [Embeddable Payout Widget](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/embed/usd-to-pkr): a static backlink card for any publisher — active mid-market rate, SWIFT intermediary cut and the real net take-home on a $1,000 invoice in a single iframe (all 50 corridors live at /embed/<slug>/).

## PayoutDelta References

- [Machine-readable corridor + rate feed (JSON)](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/api/fees.json): the full 50-corridor dataset with per-platform fees and FX spreads, refreshed daily.
- [API access & webhook contract](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/api-access): integration reference for the static feed and derived endpoints.
- [Full 50-corridor manifest](https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta/llms-full.txt): the complete table of intermediary cuts, correspondent BICs, purpose codes and recommended rails below.
